ucs.title: [LLM] TA505 / Clop (FIN11 cluster) MOVEit Transfer LEMURLOOT webshell post-exploitation chain
ucs.description: Hunts IIS w3wp.exe (running the MOVEitDMZ AppPool identity) writing .aspx files into the MOVEit Transfer wwwroot or spawning interactive shells / recon binaries — the canonical post-T1190 footprint of TA505's Clop / GOLD TAHOE LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) webshell that drove the 2023 MOVEit data-theft extortion wave attributed by Microsoft (Lace Tempest / DEV-0950) and Mandiant (UNC4857 / FIN11).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="w3wp.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","hostname.exe","tasklist.exe","reg.exe") AND (Processes.parent_process="*MOVEitDMZ*" OR Processes.parent_process="*MOVEit*" OR Processes.parent_process="*wwwroot*") by host, user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | append [| tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.process_name="w3wp.exe" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEit*\\wwwroot\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEitTransfer\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\HTBin\\*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.ashx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.asp" OR Filesystem.file_name="human*.aspx*") by host, Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let MoveItHints = dynamic(["MOVEit","MOVEitDMZ","MOVEitTransfer","wwwroot\\guestaccess","\\HTBin\\"]);
let RecoiledShells = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","hostname.exe","tasklist.exe","reg.exe"]);
let ShellSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
    | where FileName in~ (RecoiledShells)
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (MoveItHints)
          or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (MoveItHints)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              EventClass = "w3wp-shell-spawn",
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256;
let AspxDrop = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
    | where FolderPath has_any (MoveItHints)
    | where FileName endswith ".aspx" or FileName endswith ".ashx" or FileName endswith ".asp"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              EventClass = "w3wp-aspx-write",
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd = strcat("FILE=", FileName),
              SHA256;
union ShellSpawn, AspxDrop
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let MoveItHints = dynamic(["MOVEit","MOVEitDMZ","MOVEitTransfer","wwwroot\\guestaccess","HTBin"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\w3wp.exe"
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\net.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\net1.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\whoami.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\nltest.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\systeminfo.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\tasklist.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\reg.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any (MoveItHints)
      or ParentProcessName has_any (MoveItHints)
      or SubjectUserName has "MOVEitDMZ"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer,
          Account = SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcessName,
          NewProcessName,
          CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: TA505 Clop MOVEit (LEMURLOOT) Webshell Post-Exploitation Child Process
id: 4d6a2b58-9ab2-4f1c-9eaa-cb01c8e1d7a4
status: experimental
description: Detects IIS w3wp.exe (MOVEitDMZ AppPool identity) spawning interactive shells or recon binaries against the MOVEit Transfer application root — characteristic of TA505 / FIN11 / Lace Tempest Clop LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) post-exploitation activity.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/06/02/clop-extorts-companies-using-moveit-zero-day/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/zero-day-moveit-data-theft
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.initial-access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.g0092
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
      - '\systeminfo.exe'
      - '\tasklist.exe'
      - '\reg.exe'
  moveit_context:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'MOVEitDMZ'
      - 'MOVEitTransfer'
      - 'MOVEit'
      - 'wwwroot\\guestaccess'
  condition: parent and child and moveit_context
falsepositives:
  - Administrator running maintenance scripts inside the MOVEit Transfer AppPool. The IIS worker should never legitimately invoke cmd / powershell / net / nltest.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE OR *\\W3wp.exe) @Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\PWSH.EXE OR *\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\NET1.EXE OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\WHOAMI.EXE OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\NLTEST.EXE OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\SYSTEMINFO.EXE OR *\\reg.exe OR *\\REG.EXE) (@ParentCommandLine:(*MOVEit* OR *MOVEITDMZ* OR *MOVEitDMZ* OR *MOVEitTransfer* OR *moveit*) OR @CommandLine:(*MOVEit* OR *moveit* OR *wwwroot\\guestaccess*) OR @User:(*MOVEitDMZ* OR *MOVEitSvc*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/w3wp\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh|net|net1|whoami|nltest|systeminfo|tasklist|reg)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(MOVEit|MOVEitDMZ|MOVEitTransfer|wwwroot\\\\guestaccess|\\\\HTBin\\\\)", field=ParentCommandLine) OR regex("(?i)(MOVEit|wwwroot\\\\guestaccess)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentCommandLine, CommandLine], function=[count(as=hits), min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen)])

ucs.title: [LLM] TA505 / Indrik Spider Clop pre-encryption recovery inhibition + service-stop burst
ucs.description: Detects the same host running >=2 of vssadmin / wmic shadowcopy / bcdedit / wbadmin recovery-inhibition commands inside a 10-minute window, optionally paired with a service-stop spree — the canonical pre-encryption handler TA505 ships with Clop (and historically Locky / BitPaymer / WastedLocker via Evil Corp / Indrik Spider / Manatee Tempest) to neutralise backups before the file-rename loop starts (T1490 + T1489 + T1486).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" AND Processes.process="*stop*" AND Processes.process="*(MSExchange*|SQL*|Veeam*|backup*|VSS*)*") by host, user, Processes.process_name, _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats dc(process_name) as TechniqueCount values(process_name) as Techniques values(cmdlines) as cmdlines values(parents) as ParentChain min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by host, user, _time | where TechniqueCount >= 2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Window = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Technique = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"), "VSSAdmin-DeleteShadows",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete", "WMIC-ShadowCopyDelete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy" or ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled"), "BCDEdit-DisableRecovery",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "catalog", "WBAdmin-DeleteCatalog",
    FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSExchange","MSSQL","SQLAgent","Veeam","Backup","VSS","BackupExec"), "Net-StopBackupService",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Technique)
| summarize TechniqueCount = dcount(Technique),
            Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            CmdLines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            ParentCmds = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Window = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend Technique = case(
    BinName == "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"), "VSSAdmin-DeleteShadows",
    BinName == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete", "WMIC-ShadowCopyDelete",
    BinName == "bcdedit.exe" and (CommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy" or CommandLine has "recoveryenabled"), "BCDEdit-DisableRecovery",
    BinName == "wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "catalog", "WBAdmin-DeleteCatalog",
    BinName == "net.exe" and CommandLine has "stop" and CommandLine has_any ("MSExchange","MSSQL","SQLAgent","Veeam","Backup","VSS","BackupExec"), "Net-StopBackupService",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Technique)
| summarize TechniqueCount = dcount(Technique),
            Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            CmdLines = make_set(CommandLine, 8),
            ParentChain = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE OR *\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE OR *\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE) (@CommandLine:(*delete*shadows* OR *Delete*Shadows* OR *DELETE*SHADOWS*) OR @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy*delete* OR *ShadowCopy*Delete* OR *SHADOWCOPY*DELETE*) OR @CommandLine:(*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures* OR *BootStatusPolicy*ignoreallfailures*) OR @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled*no* OR *RecoveryEnabled*No*) OR @CommandLine:(*delete*catalog*quiet* OR *Delete*Catalog*) OR (@CommandLine:(*stop* OR *Stop*) AND @CommandLine:(*MSExchange* OR *MSSQL* OR *Veeam* OR *Backup* OR *VSS* OR *BackupExec*)))
